entities.summary: Boris Stepanov was a Russian boxer. He competed in the men's bantamweight event at the 1956 Summer Olympics. At the 1956 Summer Olympics in Melbourne, he received a bye in the Round of 64 and then lost by knockout to Frederick Gilroy of Ireland in the Round of 32.
